chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān that he said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a man who has nothing with him except trousers, so he said: "He should untie the waistband from it and place it upon his shoulder and perform salat. And if he has a sword with him and does not have a garment, then he should gird himself with the sword and perform salat standing."

key_terms.التِّكَّةَ: the waistband or drawstring to be removed and placed on the shoulder
key_terms.ثَوْبٌ: a garment or cloth, whose absence is central to the ruling
key_terms.سَرَاوِيلُ: trousers, the only available clothing mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.سَيْفٌ: a sword, used here as something to gird oneself with when no garment is available
key_terms.عَاتِقِهِ: his shoulder, where the waistband is to be placed
key_terms.قَائِمًا: standing, describing the posture of prayer in this case
key_terms.يُصَلِّي: he performs salat, indicating the legal act under discussion

ai.seo_question: How should a person pray if he has no garment except trousers or only a sword?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who lacks sufficient clothing for salat. It explains a minimal way of covering or presenting oneself in prayer by using what is available, showing the importance of maintaining salat even in constrained circumstances.
